column2: Month ○, Day × — Clear
I don't have anyone to talk to except $$おにいちゃん$$...
So today I read $$おにいちゃん$$ a picture book...!
But I guess $$おにいちゃん$$ didn't like it, because you didn't say anything...
Hmph! Tomorrow I'll try a different picture book, so there!
Month △, Day ○ — Rain
Even though I keep the $$おはね$$ you always stroked all nice and clean, $$おにいちゃん$$...
$$おにいちゃん$$ still won't say anything to me today...
If I become an even better girl...
Will $$おにいちゃん$$ talk to me then, I wonder???
Month ◇, Day ◎ — Cloudy
Today, starting this morning, I drew a picture of my dear $$おにいちゃん$$...
But...
I just couldn't draw $$おにいちゃん$$'s eyes right, so...
I tore them all up and threw them away...
Aww...
What do I have to do to draw $$おにいちゃん$$'s eyes properly...?
Month □, Day × — Clear
I slept with $$おにいちゃん$$ again last night...
$$おにいちゃん$$'s chest is so, so warm...
It goes thump-thump.
When I listen to the sound in $$おにいちゃん$$'s chest, I feel so safe...
I listen to the thump-thump... and then...
Before I know it, I guess I've fallen asleep. It's kind of a waste...
But, but...
I think I want to sleep beside $$おにいちゃん$$ forever...
Month ○, Day ■ — Clear
To my sleepyhead $$おにいちゃん$$...
Just being with $$おにいちゃん$$...
Makes me sooo happy!!
But...
But, but, but...!
I wanna hear $$おにいちゃん$$'s voice sooo soon...!
